releaseName: Standalone School System Admin Professional Closure 2026-09-17
closures: single-school standalone installation mode is explicit
platform tenant-elevation API is not published by default in standalone mode
school system management is task-first and hides SaaS/platform operating concepts
normal school management UI allows exactly one school authority record
colleges and offices belong to organization/department hierarchy instead of new school records
department forms auto-bind the only school in standalone mode
standalone local superuser can write only inside the single configured school
professional read-only runtime checks cover school/org/roles/MySQL/security/MFA/mail/backup/platform boundary
runtime status never exposes passwords tokens or encryption keys
server-side check_school_system command fails closed on blockers
database restore remains a controlled server workflow and is not exposed as one-click browser mutation
existing RBAC exact permission identity, role copy boundary, audit and HR usability remain intact
runtimeBoundary: Real Django startup, MySQL migrations, local admin login, SMTP/SSO integrations and backup restore still require QA or school-server execution.
